mapper.select: SELECT IP.* , SZF_GET_CMCDV_CDESC1_TEXT(#{LANGKY}, 'LOTA06', IP.LOTA06) AS LOTA06NM , (SELECT NAME01 FROM BZPTN WHERE PTNRKY = IP.LOTA09 AND PTNRTY = 'CT') AS LOTA09NM , NVL(MI.QTPUOM, 0) AS QTPUOM , SLM.PLNTKY AS ALOTA02 , SLM.STLKY AS ALOTA01 , SM.DESC01 , SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(IP.WAREKY, IP.SKUKEY, IP.QTYRCV, IP.UOMKEY, 'EA') AS QTYEA FROM INTSTKP IP LEFT JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = 'KN' AND SM.SKUKEY = IP.SKUKEY LEFT JOIN MEASI MI ON MI.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND MI.MEASKY = IP.SKUKEY AND MI.UOMKEY = 'PAL' LEFT JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND LM.LOCAKY = #{LOCAKY} LEFT JOIN ZONMA ZM ON ZM.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND ZM.ZONEKY = LM.ZONEKY LEFT JOIN STLMA SLM ON SLM.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND SLM.PLNTKY = ZM.PLNTKY AND SLM.STLKY = ZM.STLKY AND SLM.PLNTKY IN (#{PLNTKY}, ' ') WHERE IP.LOTA14 = #{LOTA14}

SELECT INTSTKP.SKUKEY , SKUMA.DESC01 , INTSTKP.QTYPHY , INTSTKP.UOMKEY , INTSTKP.LOTA02 , INTSTKP.LOTA01 , INTSTKP.PHYUSR , INTSTKP.PHYDAT , INTSTKP.PHYTIM FROM INTSTKP INNER JOIN SKUMA ON INTSTKP.SKUKEY = SKUMA.SKUKEY WHERE WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND LOCAKY = #{LOCAKY} AND PHYCHK = 'V' ORDER BY PHYDAT, PHYTIM DESC

SELECT LM.AREAKY, LM.ZONEKY, LM.LOCAKY, ZM.PLNTKY, COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM LOCMA LM LEFT JOIN ZONMA ZM ON LM.WAREKY = ZM.WAREKY AND LM.ZONEKY = ZM.ZONEKY LEFT JOIN STLMA SM ON SM.PLNTKY = ZM.PLNTKY AND SM.WAREKY = ZM.WAREKY AND SM.STLKY = ZM.STLKY WHERE 1 = 1 AND LM.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND LM.STATUS = '00' AND ZM.ZONEKY NOT IN ('SYS', 'SHP') AND (ZM.PLNTKY IN (SELECT PLNTKY FROM MTPLNT WHERE WAREKY = #{SES_WAREKY} AND MTYPE LIKE '%' || #{SES_MTYPE})) AND LM.LOCAKY = #{LOCAKY} GROUP BY LM.AREAKY, LM.ZONEKY, LM.LOCAKY, ZM.PLNTKY ORDER BY LM.AREAKY, LM.ZONEKY, LM.LOCAKY

SELECT IP.* , SZF_GET_CMCDV_CDESC1_TEXT(#{LANGKY}, 'LOTA06', IP.LOTA06) AS LOTA06NM , (SELECT NAME01 FROM BZPTN WHERE PTNRKY = IP.LOTA09 AND PTNRTY = 'CT') AS LOTA09NM , NVL(MI.QTPUOM, 0) AS QTPUOM , SLM.PLNTKY AS ALOTA02 , SLM.STLKY AS ALOTA01 , SM.DESC01 , SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(IP.WAREKY, IP.SKUKEY, IP.QTYRCV, IP.UOMKEY, 'EA') AS QTYEA FROM INTSTKP IP LEFT JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = 'KN' AND SM.SKUKEY = IP.SKUKEY LEFT JOIN MEASI MI ON MI.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND MI.MEASKY = IP.SKUKEY AND MI.UOMKEY = 'PAL' LEFT JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND LM.LOCAKY = IP.LOCAKY LEFT JOIN ZONMA ZM ON ZM.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND ZM.ZONEKY = LM.ZONEKY LEFT JOIN STLMA SLM ON SLM.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND SLM.PLNTKY = ZM.PLNTKY AND SLM.STLKY = ZM.STLKY AND SLM.PLNTKY IN (ZM.PLNTKY, ' ') WHERE IP.LOTA14 = #{LOTA14} AND IP.PHYCHK = 'V'

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT LM.AREAKY FROM LOCMA LM WHERE LM.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND LM.LOCAKY = DT.SYSLOC ) AS AREAKY , (SELECT LM.ZONEKY FROM LOCMA LM WHERE LM.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND LM.LOCAKY = DT.SYSLOC ) AS ZONEKY , DT.SYSLOC AS LOCAKY , SEQ_INTSEQ.NEXTVAL AS INTSEQ FROM DUAL A LEFT OUTER JOIN DOCTM DT ON DT.DOCUTY = '199'

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM INTSTKP IP WHERE IP.INTSEQ = #{INTSEQ} AND (IP.PHYCHK = 'V' OR IP.INTCHK = 'V')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN STD.INTSEQ IS NOT NULL THEN 'VALID_M0949' || '†INTSEQ[' || STD.INTSEQ ||']' /*자동 Palletizing된 데이터는 삭제가 불가능합니다.*/ WHEN PHYCHK_CNT > 0 THEN 'VALID_M0947' || '†INTSEQ[' || STD.INTSEQ ||']' /*실사 진행 한 데이터는 삭제가 불가능합니다.*/ WHEN INTCHK_CNT > 0 THEN 'VALID_M0948' || '†INTSEQ[' || STD.INTSEQ ||']' /*기초 생성된 데이터는 삭제가 불가능합니다.*/ ELSE 'OK' END AS RESULTMSG FROM ( SELECT IP.INTSEQ , SUM( CASE WHEN IP.PHYCHK = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS PHYCHK_CNT , SUM( CASE WHEN IP.INTCHK = 'V' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS INTCHK_CNT FROM INTSTKP IP WHERE IP.INTSEQ IN (${INTSEQS}) GROUP BY IP.INTSEQ ) STD ) WHERE RESULTMSG != 'OK' AND ROWNUM = 1

{ call P_AIRWMS_SAVE_SI02 ( #{OWNRKY, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{INTSEQ, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{WAREKY, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{LOTA02, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{SKUG05, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{DOCDAT, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{DOCTXT, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{SES_USER_ID, mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ERRORCODE, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ERRORMESG, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) }

SELECT IP.LOTA02 AS WERKS , IP.LOTA01 AS LGORT , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS BLDAT , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS GIDAT , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS ZLDAT , #{DOCDAT} AS BUDAT , 'X' AS SPERR , ' ' AS XBUFI , IP.SKUKEY AS MATNR , IP.LOTA15 AS CHARG , CASE WHEN IP.LOTA06 = '00' THEN '1' WHEN IP.LOTA06 = '05' THEN '2' ELSE '4' END AS BSTAR , ' ' AS XAMEI
, ' ' AS SBOKZ , ' ' AS KDAUF , ' ' AS KDPOS
, CASE WHEN TRIM(IP.LOTA07) IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE 'E' END AS SBOKZ , CASE WHEN TRIM(IP.LOTA07) IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE SUBSTR(IP.LOTA07, 1, 10) END AS KDAUF , CASE WHEN TRIM(IP.LOTA07) IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE SUBSTR(IP.LOTA07, 11 ) END AS KDPOS
, ' ' AS LIFNR , ' ' AS KUNNR , ' ' AS XNULL , IP.UOMKEY AS ERFME , SUM(IP.QTYPHY) AS ERFMG FROM INTSTKP IP LEFT JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.SKUKEY = IP.SKUKEY WHERE 1=1 AND IP.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND IP.LOTA02 = #{LOTA02} AND SM.SKUG05 = #{SKUG05} AND IP.PHYCHK = 'V' AND IP.INTCHK != 'V' GROUP BY IP.WAREKY , SM.SKUG05 , IP.SKUKEY , IP.UOMKEY , IP.LOTA01, IP.LOTA02 , IP.LOTA06 , IP.LOTA07 , IP.LOTA15
SELECT VALUE_COL, TEXT_COL FROM ( SELECT '10' AS VALUE_COL, 'PS' AS TEXT_COL FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '20' AS VALUE_COL, 'PS제외' AS TEXT_COL FROM DUAL ) ORDER BY VALUE_COL
SELECT CMCDVL AS VALUE_COL , CDESC1 AS TEXT_COL FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY = 'SKUG05' ORDER BY USARG2

SELECT IN_ORD , IN_CMP , IN_ORD - IN_CMP AS IN_NEW , CASE WHEN IN_ORD = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((IN_CMP/IN_ORD) * 100) END AS IN_PERCENT , DECODE(#{SKUG05}, '20', 'PLT' , '10', 'PLT' , '00', '건수' ) AS IN_UNIT FROM ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN IFWMS103.LOTA14 != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE NVL(ROUND(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM, 2), 0) END WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN MRFLG = 'S0' THEN (SELECT COUNT(0) FROM ROLLMA WHERE CONTNO = IFWMS103.SIGNI AND MATNR = IFWMS103.MATNR) ELSE 1 END ELSE NVL(ROUND(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM, 2), 0) END) AS IN_ORD , SUM(CASE WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN IFWMS103.MENGE = IFWMS103.MENGE_R THEN CASE WHEN IFWMS103.LOTA14 != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE NVL(ROUND(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM, 2), 0) END ELSE 0 END WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN MRFLG = 'S0' THEN (SELECT COUNT(0) FROM RECDI WHERE SEBELN = IFWMS103.EBELN AND SKUKEY = IFWMS103.MATNR AND STATIT = 'FRV') ELSE 1 END ELSE NVL(ROUND(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE_R, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM, 2), 0) END) AS IN_CMP FROM IFWMS103 INNER JOIN SKUMA ON IFWMS103.MATNR = SKUMA.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI PLT_MEASI ON IFWMS103.WAREKY = PLT_MEASI.WAREKY AND IFWMS103.MATNR = PLT_MEASI.MEASKY AND PLT_MEASI.UOMKEY = 'PAL' WHERE IFWMS103.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND IFWMS103.EINDT = #{DATE} AND SKUMA.SKUG05 = #{SKUG05} AND IFWMS103.STATUS != 'D' ) TMP

SELECT OUT_ORD , OUT_CMP , OUT_ORD - OUT_CMP AS OUT_NEW , CASE WHEN OUT_ORD = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((OUT_CMP/OUT_ORD) * 100) END AS OUT_PERCENT , DECODE(#{SKUG05}, '20', 'PLT' , '10', 'TON' , '00', '건수' ) AS OUT_UNIT FROM ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '00' THEN 1 -- 건수 WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '10' THEN ROUND(SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(SHPDH.WAREKY, SHPDI.SKUKEY, SHPDI.QTSHPO, SHPDI.DUOMKY, 'KG') / 1000) -- TON WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '20' THEN NVL(ROUND(SHPDI.QTSHPO/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM, 2), 1) -- PAL END) AS OUT_ORD , SUM(CASE WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FSH' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FSH' THEN ROUND(SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(SHPDH.WAREKY, SHPDI.SKUKEY, SHPDI.QTSHPO, SHPDI.DUOMKY, 'KG') / 1000) ELSE 0 END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '20' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FSH' THEN NVL(ROUND(SHPDI.QTSHPO/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM, 2), 1) ELSE 0 END END) AS OUT_CMP FROM SHPDH INNER JOIN SHPDI ON SHPDH.SHPOKY = SHPDI.SHPOKY LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI TOM_MEASI ON SHPDH.WAREKY = TOM_MEASI.WAREKY AND SHPDI.SKUKEY = TOM_MEASI.MEASKY AND TOM_MEASI.UOMKEY = 'KG' LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI PLT_MEASI ON SHPDH.WAREKY = PLT_MEASI.WAREKY AND SHPDI.SKUKEY = PLT_MEASI.MEASKY AND PLT_MEASI.UOMKEY = 'PAL' WHERE SHPDH.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND SHPDH.RQSHPD = #{DATE} AND SHPDI.SKUG05 = #{SKUG05} AND SHPDH.STATDO != 'OCN' ) TMP

SELECT DAT.CHKDAT , CASE WHEN NVL(OUT_ORD, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((NVL(OUT_CMP, 0)/NVL(OUT_ORD, 0)) * 100) END AS OUT_PERCENT FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{DATE}, 'YYYYMMDD') - (LEVEL - 1), 'YYYYMMDD') AS CHKDAT FROM DUAL CONNECT BY 5 >= LEVEL ) DAT LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '00' THEN 1 WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '10' THEN ROUND(SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(SHPDH.WAREKY, SHPDI.SKUKEY, SHPDI.QTSHPO, SHPDI.DUOMKY, 'KG') / 1000) WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '20' THEN NVL(CEIL(SHPDI.QTSHPO/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) END) AS OUT_ORD , SUM(CASE WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FSH' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FSH' THEN ROUND(SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(SHPDH.WAREKY, SHPDI.SKUKEY, SHPDI.QTSHPO, SHPDI.DUOMKY, 'KG') / 1000) ELSE 0 END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '20' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FSH' THEN NVL(CEIL(SHPDI.QTSHPO/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) ELSE 0 END END) AS OUT_CMP , SHPDH.RQSHPD FROM SHPDH INNER JOIN SHPDI ON SHPDH.SHPOKY = SHPDI.SHPOKY LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI TOM_MEASI ON SHPDH.WAREKY = TOM_MEASI.WAREKY AND SHPDI.SKUKEY = TOM_MEASI.MEASKY AND TOM_MEASI.UOMKEY = 'KG' LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI PLT_MEASI ON SHPDH.WAREKY = PLT_MEASI.WAREKY AND SHPDI.SKUKEY = PLT_MEASI.MEASKY AND PLT_MEASI.UOMKEY = 'PAL' WHERE SHPDH.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND SHPDH.RQSHPD >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{DATE}, 'YYYYMMDD') - 4, 'YYYYMMDD') AND SHPDH.RQSHPD <= #{DATE} AND SHPDH.STATDO != 'OCN' AND SHPDI.SKUG05 = #{SKUG05} GROUP BY SHPDH.RQSHPD ) TMP ON DAT.CHKDAT = TMP.RQSHPD ORDER BY DAT.CHKDAT

SELECT DAT.CHKDAT , CASE WHEN NVL(IN_ORD, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((NVL(IN_CMP, 0)/NVL(IN_ORD, 0)) * 100) END AS IN_PERCENT FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{DATE}, 'YYYYMMDD') - (LEVEL - 1), 'YYYYMMDD') AS CHKDAT FROM DUAL CONNECT BY 5 >= LEVEL ) DAT LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN IFWMS103.LOTA14 != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE NVL(CEIL(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) END WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN MRFLG = 'S0' THEN (SELECT COUNT(0) FROM ROLLMA WHERE CONTNO = IFWMS103.SIGNI AND MATNR = IFWMS103.MATNR) ELSE 1 END ELSE NVL(CEIL(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) END) AS IN_ORD , SUM(CASE WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN IFWMS103.MENGE = IFWMS103.MENGE_R THEN CASE WHEN IFWMS103.LOTA14 != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE NVL(CEIL(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) END ELSE 0 END WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN MRFLG = 'S0' THEN (SELECT COUNT(0) FROM RECDI WHERE SEBELN = IFWMS103.EBELN AND SKUKEY = IFWMS103.MATNR AND STATIT = 'FRV') ELSE 1 END ELSE NVL(CEIL(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE_R, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) END) AS IN_CMP , IFWMS103.BEDAT FROM IFWMS103 INNER JOIN SKUMA ON IFWMS103.MATNR = SKUMA.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI PLT_MEASI ON IFWMS103.WAREKY = PLT_MEASI.WAREKY AND IFWMS103.MATNR = PLT_MEASI.MEASKY AND PLT_MEASI.UOMKEY = 'PAL' WHERE IFWMS103.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND IFWMS103.EINDT >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{DATE}, 'YYYYMMDD') - 4, 'YYYYMMDD') AND IFWMS103.EINDT <= #{DATE} AND IFWMS103.STATUS != 'D' AND SKUMA.SKUG05 = #{SKUG05} GROUP BY IFWMS103.BEDAT ) TMP ON DAT.CHKDAT = TMP.BEDAT ORDER BY DAT.CHKDAT

SELECT DECODE(IN_ORD, 0, 0, ROUND(IN_CMP / IN_ORD * 100)) AS IN_CMP , DECODE(IN_ORD, 0, 0, ROUND((IN_ORD - IN_CMP) / IN_ORD * 100)) AS IN_NEW FROM ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN IFWMS103.LOTA14 != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE NVL(CEIL(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) END WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN MRFLG = 'S0' THEN (SELECT COUNT(0) FROM ROLLMA WHERE CONTNO = IFWMS103.SIGNI AND MATNR = IFWMS103.MATNR) ELSE 1 END ELSE NVL(CEIL(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) END) AS IN_ORD , SUM(CASE WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN IFWMS103.MENGE = IFWMS103.MENGE_R THEN CASE WHEN IFWMS103.LOTA14 != ' ' THEN 1 ELSE NVL(CEIL(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) END ELSE 0 END WHEN SKUMA.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN MRFLG = 'S0' THEN (SELECT COUNT(0) FROM RECDI WHERE SEBELN = IFWMS103.EBELN AND SKUKEY = IFWMS103.MATNR AND STATIT = 'FRV') ELSE 1 END ELSE NVL(CEIL(SZF_GET_DEFAULT_QTY(IFWMS103.WAREKY, IFWMS103.MATNR, IFWMS103.MENGE_R, IFWMS103.MEINS)/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) END) AS IN_CMP FROM IFWMS103 INNER JOIN SKUMA ON IFWMS103.MATNR = SKUMA.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI PLT_MEASI ON IFWMS103.WAREKY = PLT_MEASI.WAREKY AND IFWMS103.MATNR = PLT_MEASI.MEASKY AND PLT_MEASI.UOMKEY = 'PAL' WHERE IFWMS103.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND IFWMS103.EINDT = #{DATE} AND SKUMA.SKUG05 = #{SKUG05} AND IFWMS103.STATUS != 'D' ) TMP

SELECT DECODE(OUT_ORD, 0, 0, ROUND(OUT_NEW / OUT_ORD * 100)) AS OUT_NEW , DECODE(OUT_ORD, 0, 0, ROUND(OUT_FAL / OUT_ORD * 100)) AS OUT_FAL , DECODE(OUT_ORD, 0, 0, ROUND(OUT_FPC / OUT_ORD * 100)) AS OUT_FPC , DECODE(OUT_ORD, 0, 0, ROUND(OUT_FCK / OUT_ORD * 100)) AS OUT_FCK , DECODE(OUT_ORD, 0, 0, ROUND(OUT_CMP / OUT_ORD * 100)) AS OUT_CMP FROM ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '00' THEN 1 WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '10' THEN ROUND(SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(SHPDH.WAREKY, SHPDI.SKUKEY, SHPDI.QTSHPO, SHPDI.DUOMKY, 'KG') / 1000) WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '20' THEN NVL(CEIL(SHPDI.QTSHPO/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) END) AS OUT_ORD , SUM(CASE WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'NEW' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'NEW' THEN ROUND(SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(SHPDH.WAREKY, SHPDI.SKUKEY, SHPDI.QTSHPO, SHPDI.DUOMKY, 'KG') / 1000) ELSE 0 END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '20' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'NEW' THEN NVL(CEIL(SHPDI.QTSHPO/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) ELSE 0 END END) AS OUT_NEW -- 출고예정 , SUM(CASE WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FAL' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FAL' THEN ROUND(SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(SHPDH.WAREKY, SHPDI.SKUKEY, SHPDI.QTSHPO, SHPDI.DUOMKY, 'KG') / 1000) ELSE 0 END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '20' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FAL' THEN NVL(CEIL(SHPDI.QTSHPO/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) ELSE 0 END END) AS OUT_FAL -- 할당완료 , SUM(CASE WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FPC' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FPC' THEN ROUND(SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(SHPDH.WAREKY, SHPDI.SKUKEY, SHPDI.QTSHPO, SHPDI.DUOMKY, 'KG') / 1000) ELSE 0 END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '20' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FPC' THEN NVL(CEIL(SHPDI.QTSHPO/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) ELSE 0 END END) AS OUT_FPC -- 피킹완료 , SUM(CASE WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FCK' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FCK' THEN ROUND(SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(SHPDH.WAREKY, SHPDI.SKUKEY, SHPDI.QTSHPO, SHPDI.DUOMKY, 'KG') / 1000) ELSE 0 END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '20' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FCK' THEN NVL(CEIL(SHPDI.QTSHPO/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) ELSE 0 END END) AS OUT_FCK -- 상차완료 , SUM(CASE WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '00' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FSH' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '10' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FSH' THEN ROUND(SZF_GET_CONVERT_QTY(SHPDH.WAREKY, SHPDI.SKUKEY, SHPDI.QTSHPO, SHPDI.DUOMKY, 'KG') / 1000) ELSE 0 END WHEN SHPDI.SKUG05 = '20' THEN CASE WHEN SHPDH.STATDO = 'FSH' THEN NVL(CEIL(SHPDI.QTSHPO/PLT_MEASI.QTPUOM), 1) ELSE 0 END END) AS OUT_CMP -- 출고완료 FROM SHPDH INNER JOIN SHPDI ON SHPDH.SHPOKY = SHPDI.SHPOKY LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI TOM_MEASI ON SHPDH.WAREKY = TOM_MEASI.WAREKY AND SHPDI.SKUKEY = TOM_MEASI.MEASKY AND TOM_MEASI.UOMKEY = 'KG' LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI PLT_MEASI ON SHPDH.WAREKY = PLT_MEASI.WAREKY AND SHPDI.SKUKEY = PLT_MEASI.MEASKY AND PLT_MEASI.UOMKEY = 'PAL' WHERE SHPDH.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND SHPDH.RQSHPD = #{DATE} AND SHPDI.SKUG05 = #{SKUG05} AND SHPDH.STATDO != 'OCN' ) TMP

SELECT AREAKY , SHORTX AS GUBUN , MAXCPC AS KPCAPA -- 보관CAPA , STOK AS QTSIWH -- 재고량 , CASE WHEN STOK > MAXCPC THEN 0 ELSE MAXCPC - STOK END AS CLRNCE -- 여유 , CASE WHEN MAXCPC > 0 THEN CEIL((STOK / MAXCPC) * 100) ELSE 0 END AS PERLOD -- 적재율 FROM ( SELECT AREMA.AREAKY , AREMA.SHORTX , AREMA.MAXCPC , SUM(CASE WHEN STKKY.STOKKY IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS STOK FROM AREMA INNER JOIN ZONMA ON AREMA.WAREKY = ZONMA.WAREKY AND AREMA.AREAKY = ZONMA.AREAKY INNER JOIN LOCMA ON ZONMA.WAREKY = LOCMA.WAREKY AND ZONMA.AREAKY = LOCMA.AREAKY AND ZONMA.ZONEKY = LOCMA.ZONEKY INNER JOIN MTPLNT ON ZONMA.WAREKY = MTPLNT.WAREKY AND ZONMA.PLNTKY = MTPLNT.PLNTKY LEFT OUTER JOIN STKKY ON LOCMA.WAREKY = STKKY.WAREKY AND LOCMA.AREAKY = STKKY.AREAKY AND LOCMA.ZONEKY = STKKY.ZONEKY AND LOCMA.LOCAKY = STKKY.LOCAKY WHERE AREMA.WAREKY = #{WAREKY} AND AREMA.AREATY = 'STOR' GROUP BY AREMA.AREAKY , AREMA.SHORTX , AREMA.MAXCPC ORDER BY AREMA.AREAKY ) TMP
